fullDescription: A professional, data-driven HR tech assessment report design system. Featuring a clean editorial layout, technical typography pairings, and a 'paper-like' central container optimized for digital reading and PDF export. Key elements include corporate blue accents (#2563eb), structured data grids, radar charts, and high-readability prose sections. Suitable for SaaS dashboards, recruitment platforms, talent management systems, and enterprise internal tools.
prompt:
## Resumo
A high-fidelity assessment report interface featuring a multi-column sidebar, a utility header, and a centralized, high-contrast report card with specialized sections for skills analytics, textual feedback, and hiring recommendations.

## Estilo Visual
Apply an 'Enterprise Modern' design style. 
- **Typography**: Primary font 'Plus Jakarta Sans'. Body text: 14px (sm), line-height: 1.5. Headers: Tracking-tight, font-weight 700-900. Mono font: 'JetBrains Mono' for numeric scores and IDs.
- **Color Palette**: Primary Blue (#2563eb), Background Slate-50 (#f8fafc), Border Slate-200 (#e2e8f0), Success Green (#16a34a), Warning Amber (#d97706).
- **Shadows**: Report card shadow: `0 10px 40px -10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08)`. Button shadows: `0 20px 25px -5px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.1)`.
- **Borders**: Standard 1px width, 16px (rounded-2xl) or 24px (rounded-3xl) corner radius.
- **Micro-interactions**: Hover scales (1.05x) for floating buttons, smooth transitions for navigation items, and focus rings with 2px offset for accessibility.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Sidebar & Navigation
Width: 288px (w-72). Background: White (#ffffff) with border-r (Slate-200). Header: 24px padding with logo and system title. Nav Items: 40px height, 12px horizontal gap, 14px font-size. Active state: Blue-50 background with Blue-600 text. Bottom: 'Report Status' info box in Blue-50.

### App Utility Header
Height: 64px (h-16). Background: White. Layout: Flex justify-between with 32px (px-8) horizontal padding. Left: Back button and report title with a vertical separator. Right: Primary (Blue-600) and Secondary (Bordered) action buttons for sharing/exporting.

### Report Header & Candidate Card
Container: 960px width, White background, rounded-3xl, 48px padding (p-12). Layout: Top section uses flex justify-between. Left: Profile section with 80x80px (w-20 h-20) avatar (16px radius), 30px title font. Below profile: 3-column grid for meta-data (Date, Duration, Interviewer) with 10px uppercase labels. Right: Floating Score Badge.

### Analytics Section
Layout: 2-column grid (md:grid-cols-2) with 48px (gap-12). Left Col: Radar chart (SVG) scaled 1.25x with Slate-500 axis labels. Right Col: Strengths and Weaknesses lists. Use 32px (pl-8) left padding for the list column. List items: 10px vertical gap, 14px text, Lucide icons (Green/Amber) for bullets.

### Feedback & Recommendations
Feedback: 14px font, line-height 1.5, Max-width: 768px (max-w-3xl). Paragraphs use 24px (indent-6) first-line indentation. Recommendations: 3-column grid with gap-6. Each card: 20px padding (p-5), border-1 (Slate-100), rounded-2xl. Primary recommendation uses Blue-50 background.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Score Badge — High-impact numeric score display.
Dimensions: Auto-width square-ish. Background: Blue-600. Padding: 16px. Text: White. Title: 10px bold uppercase, tracking-widest. Score: 36px font-black, JetBrains Mono font. Subtitle: 10px opacity-80. Shadow: Intense Blue-200 glow.

### Floating Action Button (FAB) — Primary floating feedback/utility trigger.
Size: 64x64px (w-16 h-16). Background: Slate-900. Shape: Circle. Shadow: `shadow-2xl shadow-blue-200/50`. Icon: 24px (text-2xl) centered. Interaction: Scale(1.1) on hover.

### Radar Chart SVG — Hexagonal skill visualization.
Size: 240px. Grid: 3 nested hexagons in Slate-200 (#e2e8f0), stroke-width 1px. Area: Blue-600 with 20% opacity (rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.2)) and 2px stroke width. Labels: Fixed positioning at hexagon vertices, 10px font-bold, Slate-500.
